Rapid Ramp Enablement Kit — micro-demos, objection scripts, and release sync

Create a compact, field-ready enablement kit for the Q1 runtime/console release targeted at Sales and Customer Success. Kit must be consumable in a single 30-minute prep session and include: 3 micro-demo scripts (2–3 minute flows each), top-10 objection-response snippets, one-page executive one-pager, quick comparator vs. major competitor tiers, annotated release notes summary for CS, and a short roleplay checklist. Focus on high-impact scenarios: latency/cost wins with batching & quantization suggestions, Dedicated capacity play, and Private deployment talking points. Coordinate with Eng for accuracy on performance numbers and with Design for a single-page visual handout.
Three micro-demo scripts (customer convo + step-by-step CLI/Console actions)
Top-10 objection-response bank with suggested follow-ups
One-page executive one-pager (PDF) summarizing customer value and pricing considerations
Release-notes TL;DR for CS to communicate to customers
50–60 second elevator pitch audio clip
Roleplay checklist and suggested discovery questions
Recording of a 30-minute enablement run-through
Sales rep can run a demo in <=3 minutes end-to-end using provided scripts
CS team has a one-page summary to send to customers within 24h of GA
Engineering signs off on all performance claims (PR with perf numbers linked)
Design approves final one-pager and demo screenshots
Enablement session scheduled and recorded; attendance >= 70% of field reps
